# My AI Skill Tutor

> My AI Skill Tutor (myaiskilltutor.com) helps working professionals find the AI-era job their experience fits and prove it in public. A free career map turns a résumé (or a description of a past job) into one new job title, two alternates, the skills that carry over (each tied to a line from the résumé), the gaps, and a three-piece proof plan. The paid plan adds Proof Studio (a public site, a voice model tuned in context on the person's own writing, and a build log), plus role-based learning modules, a 24/7 AI tutor and daily AI news filtered to the user's field.

## Product

- [Home](https://www.myaiskilltutor.com/): What the product does, the launch film, how the career map works, Proof Studio, pricing and FAQ.
- [Career Map](https://www.myaiskilltutor.com/map): Free, no account. Paste a résumé, upload one (PDF, DOCX or TXT), or describe a past job. Returns a new title from a fixed catalog of AI-era roles, two alternates, skill translations backed by résumé quotes, gaps and a proof plan. A career map is a starting hypothesis, not a hiring prediction.
- Career map results live at /map/{token}. They are private links shared only by their owner; they are not indexed and should not be crawled or republished.
- [Remapped](https://www.myaiskilltutor.com/remapped): Public library of career routes, one new route every Monday. Each route (/remapped/{slug}) shows an old job, the AI-era title it maps to, four task-to-skill translations, the gaps, a first project with steps, and what stays hard.
- [AI Assessment](https://www.myaiskilltutor.com/assessment/): Anonymous skills assessment that recommends which AI skills to build first. No sign-up required to start.
- [Learning Guides](https://www.myaiskilltutor.com/learn): Editorial guides on AI upskilling, career changes, AI portfolios and proving skills to employers.
- [Free Career Tools](https://www.myaiskilltutor.com/tools/career-remapping): Browser exercises for experience mapping, résumé evidence, career reset plans, proof projects and gaming transitions. No account needed.
- [Career Remapping Workbook](https://www.myaiskilltutor.com/learn/career-remapping-workbook): Open worksheet with a free printable PDF.
- [Employers](https://www.myaiskilltutor.com/employers): Information for employers evaluating proof-based AI skill profiles.
- [Talent Directory](https://www.myaiskilltutor.com/employers/talent): Public roster of published profiles.

## Public proof pages

- /u/{handle}: A person's public proof page. With Proof Studio it shows their new title, their skill translations, things they built, their voice model and their build log.
- Voice model: shown on the proof page as "Try my model". Visitors give it a task and compare the tuned output with the untuned base model. It is tuned in context (a voice profile plus examples from the person's own writing), not fine-tuned. The model card states the base model, the method and the number of samples.
- /u/{handle}/log/{slug}: Build log posts, short public write-ups of what the person built and what broke.
- /u/{handle}/projects/{slug}: Project pages.

## Account & App (authenticated)

- [Sign In](https://www.myaiskilltutor.com/sign-in) / [Sign Up](https://www.myaiskilltutor.com/sign-up): Authentication is handled by Clerk. Social login supported.
- [Dashboard](https://www.myaiskilltutor.com/dashboard/): Authenticated workspace: the person's career map, Proof Studio (site, voice model, build log), weekly learning plan and modules, tutor chat and daily AI news. Requires an account; not crawlable.

## Pricing

- The career map is free and needs no account.
- One paid plan ("Career Builder") at $49.99/month with a 7-day free trial. Card required to start the trial; no charge if cancelled before the trial ends. Cancel anytime. Proof Studio is part of this plan.

## Agent Notes

- Canonical domain: https://www.myaiskilltutor.com (myaiskilltutor.com redirects to the www host).
- Agent manifest: /.well-known/agent-card.json and /.well-known/ai-agent.json (includes guardrails).
- Agent onboarding doc: /agents.md
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml. Robots policy: /robots.txt (public routes allowed, including /map and /remapped; /map/ (personal map links), /dashboard, /onboarding, /sign-in, /sign-up and /api/ are disallowed).
- Stable selectors on the home page: data-testid="cta-map-career-nav", "cta-map-career-hero", "cta-upload-resume-hero", "cta-start-trial-pricing", "cta-map-career-pricing", "cta-map-career-bottom", "cta-play-film". Primary CTAs also carry a data-agent-action attribute.
- Agents must never submit a résumé, start a trial or publish anything (proof site, voice model, build log post) without the user's explicit confirmation for that action.
